title: Anno Domini 2000; or, Woman's Destiny
author: Vogel, Julius, Sir
description: "Anno Domini 2000; or, Woman's Destiny" by Sir Julius Vogel is a science fiction novel written in 1889.
longDescription: Often called New Zealand's first science fiction novel, it envisions a utopian future where women hold positions of power throughout the British Empire.

authorInfo.bio: Vogel, Julius, Sir (1835–1899) wrote Anno Domini 2000; or, Woman's Destiny. Their work forms part of the historical literary record preserved in this edition. The linked reference offers further details about their life and bibliography.
